criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: Single-stage progression keeps attention locked on the folding sheet; stepper clearly indicates current progress 1/4 -> 4/4; callouts only point to the active fold.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: Playfair Display for display words and headings, JetBrains Mono for HUD labels and stepper nodes. Clean letter-spacing (0.12em) and high contrast.

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: Dedicated vertical layout with art in the upper safe tier (height 44%) and instructions/stepper in the lower tier. Safe margins top 128px and bottom 256px strictly respected.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Opening kinetic word beats on 0.9s intervals, folds pace at ~2.4s per step allowing comfortable reading, 2s glide and 3s hold on closing card.

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: Off-white paper (#FBFBFA / #F4EFE6) with dark ink (#1E1B16) exceeds WCAG AAA; accent terracotta provides clear visual feedback.

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: Editorial-light style system with paper-craft aesthetic, warm tones, and hand-drawn callout annotations directly reflecting reference research (ref-c3bc609841, ref-392ee4d0f9).

criteria.question: Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
criteria.notes: Full stop of 'Fly.' blooms into the notebook page; landing dot of flight path blooms into closing end card. Every transition has continuity.

criteria.question: Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
criteria.notes: Consistent line weights, pen-led drawing strokes for crease lines, and matching hand-drawn callouts throughout.

criteria.question: No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
criteria.notes: Zero decorative filler. Every movement either folds the plane, reveals a step, or traces the flight.

criteria.question: No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
criteria.notes: Continuous visual evolution every 0.8–2s fulfilling the Anti-Laziness Mandate.

criteria.question: No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
criteria.notes: Zero overlaps or clipping; HUD corners clear system chrome; stepper remains above the 256px bottom safe zone.

criteria.question: Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.
criteria.notes: High-energy word-beat opening ('Fold. Crease. Fly.'), deliberate step-by-step fold instructional body, pay-off flight arc, and closing takeaway card holding for >2.5s.

pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
